items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I told Cab -- I said a friend of mine in Chicago, Stump Evans, and I said -- couldn't get a better man.

ctx.x: Well, we've just gone back to Hawk and everything too. He -- well, what about Stump Evans? I mean was he -- I mean -- or did you leave before he sort of made it?

Yeah, I left before 'Cause when Stump Evans Cab wanted me to go on alto, back on alto. I told Cab -- I said a friend of mine in Chicago, Stump Evans, and I said -- couldn't get a better man. I wasn't going to (Unintelligible) switching back to the alto. And -- but Stump had gotten sick. I think he got pneumonia or TB or something like that.
You see, I always thought of him as an alto player said oh no, I never (unintelligible), but Earl Hines (unintelligible).
